title: scenario@1
description: A deterministic headless encounter. encounter_runner loads `pack` (and its depends), builds one chunk from `board` (an authored chunk file, or an open 32x32 map), replaces spawns with `party` then `monsters` in array order, and runs the built-in nearest-enemy policy on every creature from `seed` until the end condition or `round_cap`. Stable ids are spawn_stable_id(chunk coord, index) with the party first. Surprise is applied before the first command. Integers only (4.3). Not a pack document: files live in scenarios/<name>/scenario.json beside golden.txt.

id.description: Roster id, unique in the scenario. Used by surprise and the runner's report. Not the combatant id.

archetype.description: Content id in the scenario pack or its depends. Party entries must be characters; monster entries must be monsters.

team.description: Faction id (spawn overrides.team). Default: party for party entries, monsters for monster entries.

id.description: Scenario id, unique under scenarios/. Example: sample.fighter_vs_goblin.

seed.description: Encounter RNG seed (Pcg32). The same seed and content produce byte-identical runner output.

pack.description: Pack id under content/packs whose closure supplies archetypes. A chunk path is relative to this pack.

board.description: Exactly one of an authored chunk or a flat map. Spawns in a chunk file are replaced by the roster.

chunk.description: Pack-relative chunk@1 or chunk@2 file. No '..' segments.

blocked.description: Wall tiles (blocks move and sight) on an otherwise open 32x32 floor. Chunk coord is (0, 0, 0).

surprise.description: Either roster ids that start surprised, or hiders whose Dexterity (Stealth) totals surprise whoever cannot perceive them (rules5e::surprised_by_stealth). An empty array surprises nobody.

end_condition.description: teams: a team with nobody conscious (the sim default). no_pc_conscious: no conscious PC. no_pc_or_no_opponent: no conscious PC, or every non-PC unconscious or dead. Checked before the round cap.

round_cap.description: When the round becomes greater than this, the encounter ends with EndReason::Custom if the end condition has not already fired.
